clue.text: Religious law would harm anyone to some extent

indicators.note: only part of the following words is used, so the answer sits partly inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of would, all of harm and the start of anyone

explanation.surface: A warning that strict religious law would do some harm to everybody.
explanation.definitionFit: In Hindu and Buddhist thought this is the cosmic order and the moral duty a believer must follow.

clue.text: Old-fashioned when receiving short order and seriously committed

clue.text: Build up a holiday island, as you might say

clue.text: This person has a story for your ear?

clue.text: Complained, having desire to be laid up?

clue.text: The female's love is offered to male for selfless acts

clue.text: An Italian poet here could make quite a slow movement

clue.text: The guy with a supply of food that can be cooked?

taken as written

clue.text: Sierra Leone, troubled but without the extremes previously

clue.text: Article dumped outside home, yours no longer?

clue.text: Woman needs thanks for guarding explosive

clue.text: He is one of those significant contributors

taken as written

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Note to get medicine

clue.text: Essential train information in the paper
